recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. FHIR-13330 is already correctly represented in core; future ISO 3166 URI policy, CLD style, or terminology-server expansion work should remain under later dedicated trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-13330 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested a core ValueSet for ISO 3166 two-letter country codes using the existing urn:iso:std:iso:3166 code system, motivated by interoperable use such as Address.country profiles.
initial_application: No source commit names FHIR-13330 directly. Jira comments say it was defined as part of ISO 3166 changes, and commit 4c41b4e23383efa8df22cf99fdc0511105015c5b added source/terminologies/valueset-iso3166-1-2.xml plus active fhir.ini registration one day after the Vocab WG vote.
additional_context: The 2018-02-08 Vocab minutes record the same decision to create an alpha-2 ValueSet resource while retaining urn:iso:std:iso:3166 for ISO 3166 Part 1 legacy use. Later FHIR-37971 intentionally changed the alpha-2 ValueSet from an extensional list to a regex-filter CLD, and FHIR-39157 records a later expansion/tooling correction rather than a reversal of the seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope source/fhir.ini registers iso3166-1-2 and source/terminologies/valueset-iso3166-1-2.xml composes urn:iso:std:iso:3166 with a code regex of [A-Z]{2}; build.fhir.org exposes the same ValueSet URL and filter.

related_jiras.note: Resolved in the same 2018 Vocab motion and explains the retained urn:iso:std:iso:3166 policy around the ValueSet.
Changed the ISO 3166 Part 1 two-letter ValueSet from a fixed enumeration to the current regex-filter CLD.
Confirmed the later expansion problem was tooling/publication behavior and not a reversal of the source ValueSet.
